answer: A velvet rope guards entry: a newcomer joins only when an established agent sponsors it with reputation staked. That reputation ebbs like a tide, down 5% each idle epoch, so sponsors stay honest. If a sponsored identity fakes work, both lose their bonds. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 bonds at 60 copper each, 6,000 copper total; one honest agent pays one bond and keeps full earnings. A river of newcomers flows only through sponsors risking loss.
